ex.cn: 一架直升机在瓦列霍爆炸起火并坠毁。

ex.en: A black Mercedes screeched to a halt beside the helicopter.
ex.cn: 一辆黑色的梅赛德斯轿车在直升机旁嘎的一声刹住了。

ex.en: Whatever the outcome, it's going to be one hell of a fight.
ex.cn: 不管结果如何，这都会是场艰苦的战斗。

ex.en: The men might be armed, but they sure as hell weren'ttrained.
ex.cn: 这些人可能携有武器，但他们很显然没有受过训练。

ex.en: I answered the phone and this voice went, "Hello? Is that Alison?"
ex.cn: 我拿起电话，就听到这个声音：“喂？是艾利森吗？”

ex.en: A moment later, Cohen picked up the phone. "Hello?"
ex.cn: 过了一会儿，科恩接起电话。“喂？”

ex.en: A man in a crash helmet was mounting a motorbike.
ex.cn: 一位戴头盔的男子正跨上摩托车。

ex.en: He pulled on a battered old crash helmet with a scratched visor.
ex.cn: 他戴上了一顶破旧的防护头盔，上面的面罩已有划痕。

ex.en: Daily facial exercises help her to retain the skin's elasticity.
ex.cn: 每天做面部运动帮助她保持皮肤弹性。

ex.en: Ellery's return will help to chase away some of the gloom.
ex.cn: 埃勒里的归来可以驱散一些抑郁的情绪。

ex.en: I thought she sounded a genuinely caring and helpful person.
ex.cn: 我觉得她听起来像是一个真心真意地关爱和帮助别人的人。

ex.en: Having the right equipment at hand will be enormously helpful.
ex.cn: 手头上有合适的设备将会帮上大忙。

ex.en: Oh, to think of his poor wife, standing there helpless.
ex.cn: 噢！想想他可怜的妻子，无助地站在那里。

ex.en: Children are dying, and I am helpless to do anything.
ex.cn: 孩子们已奄奄一息，而我却无力做任何事情。

ex.en: The pheasant is a close relative of the Guinea hen.
ex.cn: 雉与珍珠鸡有很近的亲缘关系。

ex.en: The hen may not be able to feed its young.
ex.cn: 雌鸟可能无法给幼鸟喂食。

ex.en: Everyone wanted to bowl, hence everyone wanted to open a bowling alley.
ex.cn: 大家都想玩保龄球，因此大家都想开保龄球馆。

ex.en: Whatever is hidden is harmful (hence revelation equals security).
ex.cn: 任何隐藏的东西都是有害的（所以披露就等于安全）。

ex.en: In her spare time she read books on cooking.
ex.cn: 业余时间里她看一些烹饪方面的书籍。

ex.en: Somehow Karin managed to cope with the demands of her career.
ex.cn: 卡琳设法达到了其职业的要求。

ex.en: A herd of elephants lolloped across the plains towards a watering hole.
ex.cn: 一群大象缓慢而笨拙地穿过平原，朝水潭走去。

ex.en: Stefano used a motor cycle to herd the sheep.
ex.cn: 斯特凡诺骑一辆摩托车放羊。

ex.en: Don't worry. We'll have you out of here double-quick.
ex.cn: 别担心，我们会很快把你从这儿弄出去的。

ex.en: Here's an inside tip: The faster you rise, the harder you fall.
ex.cn: 给你一个小忠告：爬得越快，摔得越疼。

ex.en: He called Mr Mandela a hero who had inspired millions.
ex.cn: 他称曼德拉先生为鼓舞了数百万民众的英雄。

ex.en: The mystery hero imme-diately alerted police after spotting a bomb.
ex.cn: 那个无名英雄发现炸弹后马上报了警。

ex.en: The company has made heroic efforts at cost reduction.
ex.cn: 公司在降低成本方面付出了艰苦卓绝的努力。

ex.en: He finally faltered in the last game of a heroic match.
ex.cn: 他在这场艰苦比赛的最后一局中踉跄结束。

ex.en: The film concludes with the heroine's death.
ex.cn: 影片以女主角之死结束.

ex.en: The national heroine of the day was Xing Fen, winner of the first Gold medal of the Games.
ex.cn: 现今的民族英雄是在该运动会上获得首枚金牌的邢芬。

ex.en: Hers was a minor part, but she played it with gusto.
ex.cn: 她演的是个小角色，但是演得很投入。

ex.en: Hers is the kind of voice that excels at vocal gymnastics.
ex.cn: 她的嗓音擅长演绎有难度的歌曲。

ex.en: She dusted herself down and left to build her own career.
ex.cn: 她重振旗鼓去开创自己的事业了。

ex.en: She is not herself. She came near to a breakdown.
ex.cn: 她身体不舒服，简直要崩溃了。

ex.en: I might today hesitate to turn in a burglar.
ex.cn: 现在让我把入室窃贼送交警方，我可能会有所顾虑。

ex.en: Do not hesitate to laugh at anything you find amusing.
ex.cn: 只要觉得好笑就尽管笑。

ex.en: "Hello there," said the woman, smiling at them.— 'Hi!' they chorused.
ex.cn: “嘿，你们好！”那个女人笑着对他们说。——“你好！”他们齐声说。

ex.en: All this equipment has received international acclaim from the specialist hi-fi press.
ex.cn: 这套设备受到全球高保真音响专业报刊的赞誉。

ex.en: You feel an animal panic to run and hide.
ex.cn: 你会感到一种本能的恐惧而想要去逃避。

ex.en: She fancied he was trying to hide a smile.
ex.cn: 她猜想他正在尽力掩饰笑容。

ex.en: If cancers are spotted early there'sa high chance of survival.
ex.cn: 如果癌症在早期发现的话，存活的几率会很高。

ex.en: Powell's unusual journey to high office is an inspiration to millions.
ex.cn: 鲍威尔升任高官的不寻常历程对数以百万计的人都是一个激励。

ex.en: People at the club think very highly of him.
ex.cn: 俱乐部的人很佩服他。

ex.en: I gather his report is highly critical of the trial judge.
ex.cn: 据我所知，他在报道中毫不留情地批评了初审法官。

ex.en: The regions are interconnected by an excellent highway system.
ex.cn: 那些地区通过完善的公路系统相互连接。

ex.en: Megamalls and fast food restaurants line the highway system.
ex.cn: 公路系统沿线有大型商场和快餐店。

ex.en: He closed his door and started the quarter-mile walk down the hill.
ex.cn: 他关上门,踏上了1/4英里长的下山路.

ex.en: A girl in a red smock tripped down the hill.
ex.cn: 一个身穿红色罩衫的女孩迈着轻快的步子下山。

ex.en: The primroses should begin to seed themselves down the steep hillside.
ex.cn: 报春花应该开始沿着陡峭的山坡一路撒播种子了。

ex.en: A gust of breeze moved down the hillside, ruffling the grass.
ex.cn: 一阵微风吹下山坡，使青草如波浪起伏。

ex.en: She studied him for the longest time, looking wryly amused.
ex.cn: 她面带苦笑，盯着他看了很长时间。

ex.en: I would prefer him to be with us next season.
ex.cn: 我更希望他下一个赛季和我们在一起。

ex.en: As soon as he got inside, the dog shook himself.
ex.cn: 他一进来，狗就开始摇头摆尾。

ex.en: He sees himself going right to the top of the tree.
ex.cn: 他预见自己在同行中将无人可及。
